svg.title: Packages and their imports
svg.desc: In place: an import graph of 230 packages with 837 cross-package imports, 799 of them through a front door. Each row imports from the columns it shades, darker for more imports; a dashed outline marks imports that reach past the target package's front door.
svg.text: Row imports from column; columns numbered as rows
